monitoring_universe.U: All TWSE-listed common stocks available at t under PIT-safe membership; exclude TPEx, ETF, ETN, warrants, preferred shares and non-common securities.
monitoring_universe.source_cohort_E: PIT-safe TWSE-listed electronics membership used by HENGCE formal electronics universe.
monitoring_universe.industry_map: Fugle/TWSE industry classification captured at observation time; industry labels are context only and have no formal stock-selection authority.

row_level.flow_missing_policy: Missing institutional evidence is NULL, never zero-filled.
row_level.volume_missing_policy: Rows with missing or nonpositive Volume cannot contribute to flow-intensity denominator.
row_level.membership_policy: A stock contributes only if its PIT membership/security status is valid on that date.

core_formulae.flow_intensity(group, channel, w, t): sum(Net_channel[s,d] for s in group and d in last w eligible sessions through t) / sum(Volume[s,d] for same rows)
core_formulae.stock_totalnet_intensity_5(s,t): sum(TotalNet[s,d], last 5 eligible sessions) / sum(Volume[s,d], same sessions)
core_formulae.flow_breadth_negative_share: count(s in E with stock_totalnet_intensity_5(s,t)<0) / count(eligible s in E)
core_formulae.capital_migration_strength: if source_absolute_flow_5<0 and destination_absolute_flow_5>0 then destination_absolute_flow_5 - source_absolute_flow_5 else 0
core_formulae.ew_return(group,w,t): equal-weight mean across eligible stocks of Close[t]/Close[t-w]-1, requiring both endpoints
core_formulae.ma20_breadth(group,t): share of eligible stocks with Close[t] > simple moving average of prior/current 20 eligible closes
core_formulae.average_pairwise_corr20_E: mean off-diagonal Pearson correlation of daily stock returns over last 20 eligible sessions among E stocks with complete-enough observations; minimum pair observations=15

industry_rotation_context.industry_flow_intensity_5: For each TWSE industry k, flow_intensity(k,TotalNet,5,t).
industry_rotation_context.destination_industry: Non-E industry with positive industry_flow_intensity_5 and positive 5-session turnover-share change; report ranking but do not grant selection/capital authority.

time_semantics.eligible_session: TWSE trading session with required evidence for the metric; no calendar-day forward-fill.
time_semantics.rolling_window: Trading-session based, ending at t; past-only detector baseline excludes current observation.
time_semantics.intraday: Fugle price/volume can update provisional price/liquidity metrics only; institutional/margin histories remain last formally verified EOD until same-day EOD is canonical.
